context: a letter from Hugh Falconer, which you are answering
exchanges:
On Saturday last—the 27th—on the receipt of your note, I posted to you— addressed to you—to Down near Bromley—a heavy letter containing some folio m.ss. in a large paid cover—4d postage.

Not having heard from you, I am afraid it may have miscarried.

Did any such letter reach you. | Yours very Sinly | H Falconer

I returned home on Tuesday evening & on Thursday I returned your M.S., with my letter, to Park Crescent, & there I have no doubt you will find it safe.— I shd. indeed be grieved if it were lost.—

In Haste | Ever yours | C. Darwin
